speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To begin our evaluation of your acute diarrhea, how long have your symptoms been present and how many loose bowel movements are you having per day?

speaker: Patient
text: 58-year-old female. The patient has been treated for community-acquired pneumonia with levofloxacin on the medical floor. She reports developing watery diarrhea with at least 9 episodes within the last two days, accompanied by lower abdominal discomfort and cramping.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Antibiotic-associated diarrhea (likely *C. difficile* infection).

Given your recent treatment with levofloxacin for pneumonia and the sudden onset of frequent watery diarrhea with cramping, this strongly suggests a complication from the antibiotic therapy. We need to confirm this with a specific stool test immediately.

REQUEST TEST: C. diff Toxin A/B Assay
REQUEST IMAGES: Abdominal_X-Ray
